scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm --filter @agenthooksprotocol/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agenthooksprotocol/testing build && pnpm --filter @agenthooksprotocol/conformance build
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const p of ['sdk', 'testing', 'conformance']) rmSync('packages/' + p + '/dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
